history.summary: A 678 sqft 1BR in Clementi at $850K / $1,254 PSF — a low, accessible quantum sitting ~14% below the $1,462 URA median, backed by a credible +4.49%/yr CAGR over 51 transactions. Clementi's One-North/NUS/science-hub demand and the cheap entry make this one of the cleaner value plays in the batch.
history.rating_rationale: PSF $1,254 is ~14% under the $1,462 URA median — a real discount, not a size artifact (678 sqft is a normal 1BR). URA appreciation +4.49%/yr on a solid 51-txn sample is reliable and above the OCR/RCR-fringe baseline. Sub-$1M quantum keeps the buyer pool deep and entry costs low. 99yr LH from 2010 leaves a comfortable lease runway.
red_flags: 1BR is a niche own-stay product, though liquid as an investment unit
No explicit MRT distance in dossier — Clementi/Dover access needs verification
catalysts: Clementi proximity to NUS, One-North, and Singapore Science Park — durable tenant base
Below-median PSF leaves room for mean-reversion upside

history.summary: A verifiably cheap unit in a Frasers-built Clementi leasehold with a credible long-horizon catalyst and a solid yield. The intra-project discount is real; lease age and thin cohort keep it at medium confidence.
history.rating_rationale: Asking $1,253 psf vs a project 12-month range of $1,394-$1,600 psf (avg ~$1,494) — the unit is ~16% below its own project's recent average, corroborating the very_low_psf flag and -25.8% age-adj / -16.4% cohort premiums with real web-verified transactions rather than a mis-scrape. Built by Frasers Centrepoint (FCL), a credible developer, mitigating build-quality risk. 3.8% gross yield is strong for a city-fringe condo. D5 (West Coast/Clementi) is a favourable RCR/OCR-adjacent region under v3.4 priors, and the area benefits from NUS/one-north/Clementi job nodes plus the Greater Southern Waterfront transformation thesis. Medium not high because psf_cohort_txns=2 is thin and the 2006 lease (~80yr left) is the oldest of the cohort.
red_flags: old_property + 99LH from 2006 (~80 years remaining) — lease decay is the real long-term drag on a leasehold this age
psf_cohort_txns=2 — own-size band shallow; verify the listing isn't a low-floor/poor-facing reason for the discount
Greater Southern Waterfront upside is a long-dated, multi-decade thesis, not a 5-7yr certainty
catalysts: Verified ~16% discount to the project's recent 12-month average PSF ($1,253 vs ~$1,494)
Reputable Frasers Centrepoint build quality lowers defect risk
Clementi / one-north / NUS employment catchment underpins resilient rental demand (3.8% yield)
Greater Southern Waterfront and West Coast rejuvenation as a long-horizon district uplift
